about.title: About Us
about.html:
Welcome to Gamez Adda

Gamez Adda is an independent online gaming and informational platform owned and operated by BHAVIK SONANI.

Our platform is designed to provide users with easy access to browser-based entertainment and publicly available application information in a simple and transparent manner.

What We Offer

1. Browser-Based HTML5 Games

Gamez Adda provides a collection of HTML5 (H5) games that can be played instantly in your browser without downloading or installing any software.

Some games may be:

  • Developed internally, or
  • Provided by independent third-party web game providers

No account registration is required to play games on our platform.

2. Informational App Pages

We may provide informational pages about mobile applications, including:

  • General descriptions
  • Screenshots
  • Publicly available details
  • Links to official app stores or developer websites

We do not host, distribute, or provide APK, IPA, or installation files.

All app download links redirect only to official app stores or verified developer websites.

Our Independence

Gamez Adda operates independently and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially connected to:

  • Google Play
  • Apple App Store
  • Any game developer or publisher

All trademarks, logos, and brand names displayed on this website belong to their respective owners.

We present content for informational and entertainment purposes only.

How We Operate

Gamez Adda is free to use.

The platform is supported through advertising services, including:

  • Google AdSense
  • Google Ad Exchange (AdX)

Advertising revenue allows us to maintain and improve our website without charging users.

We do not sell personal information.

Our Mission

Our mission is to:

  • Provide accessible browser-based entertainment
  • Maintain transparency about our services
  • Offer clear and honest redirection to official app sources
  • Operate in compliance with digital advertising and content standards

We are committed to maintaining a safe and user-friendly experience.

Contact Information

If you have any questions, feedback, or concerns, you may contact:

BHAVIK SONANI
Owner and Operator of Gamez Adda
Email:[email protected]

We aim to respond to inquiries as promptly as possible.

1. Introduction

Welcome to Gamez Adda (“we,” “our,” or “us”).

Gamez Adda is an independent online gaming and informational platform owned and operated by BHAVIK SONANI.

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect information when you visit or use our website at https://gamezadda.store.

By using this website, you agree to the terms described in this Privacy Policy.

2. About Our Services

Gamez Adda provides:

  • Browser-based HTML5 (H5) games playable directly on the website
  • Informational pages about mobile applications
  • Redirect links to official app stores or developer websites

We do not host, upload, modify, or distribute APK, IPA, or any application installation files.

Gamez Adda is not affiliated with Google Play, Apple App Store, or any developer unless explicitly stated.

3. Information We Collect

A. Automatically Collected Information

When you visit our website, certain technical information may be collected automatically, including:

  • IP address
  • Browser type and version
  • Device information
  • Operating system
  • Pages visited
  • Time spent on pages
  • Referring URLs

This information is used for analytics, performance improvement, fraud prevention, and security purposes.

We do not require user registration to play games.

B. Cookies & Tracking Technologies

Gamez Adda uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to:

  • Improve user experience
  • Analyze website traffic
  • Serve relevant advertisements
  • Maintain security

Cookies are small data files stored on your device.

You can disable cookies through your browser settings; however, some features of the website may not function properly.

4. Advertising & Third-Party Vendors

Gamez Adda displays advertisements through third-party advertising partners, including:

  • Google AdSense
  • Google Ad Exchange (AdX)

Google and its partners may use cookies (including the DoubleClick cookie) to serve ads based on your visits to this and other websites.

Personalized ads may be shown based on browsing behavior.

You may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting: https://www.google.com/settings/ads

We do not control how third-party advertising vendors collect or use data.

5. Analytics Services

We may use analytics tools such as Google Analytics to:

  • Monitor website traffic
  • Understand user behavior
  • Improve website performance

These services may use cookies to collect anonymous usage data.

6. Browser-Based Games

Gamez Adda provides browser-based HTML5 games for entertainment purposes.

Some games may be developed internally or provided by independent third-party web game providers.

While playing these games, limited technical data may be processed to ensure proper functionality and performance.

We do not collect personal account information for gameplay.

7. External Links

Our website may contain links to:

  • Google Play Store
  • Apple App Store
  • Official developer websites
  • Other third-party websites

We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of external websites.

Users should review third-party privacy policies before providing any information on external sites.

8. Data Sharing

We do not sell, rent, or trade personal information.

Information may be shared with:

  • Advertising partners
  • Analytics providers
  • Technical service providers

Such sharing is limited to operational and monetization purposes necessary to maintain the website.

9. Children’s Privacy

Gamez Adda is not intended for children under the age of 13.

We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided personal data, please contact us at [email protected].

10. Data Security

We implement reasonable administrative and technical safeguards to protect information from unauthorized access, misuse, or disclosure.

However, no method of internet transmission is completely secure.

11. Your Privacy Rights

Depending on your location, you may have rights to:

  • Access personal data
  • Request correction
  • Request deletion
  • Withdraw consent
  • Object to certain processing activities

To exercise your rights, please contact us at:

Email:[email protected]

12. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time.

Any changes will be posted on this page with a revised effective date.

Users are encouraged to review this page periodically.

13. Contact Information

If you have questions regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact:

BHAVIK SONANI
Owner of Gamez Adda
Email:[email protected]
